Estimate contrasts using Wald Test

Source: R/Contrasts.R
Contrasts.Rd

Each contrast is a Wald test of a linear function of the model coefficients; $get_linfct() returns these coefficient weights.

Value

An R6 class generator.

Examples


# Fitting mixed effects model to peptide data
istar <- prolfqua::sim_lfq_data_peptide_config()
#> `protein_Id`: columns `proteinID`, `idtype2` united with separator '~'.
#> creating sampleName from file_name column
#> setup_analysis: dropped 6 unconfigured columns: average_prot_abundance, sd, mean, N, avg_peptide_abd, Replicate.
#> setup_analysis: added 36 rows with NA response for feature and sample combinations absent from the input.

modelFunction <-
  strategy_lmer("abundance  ~ group_ + (1 | peptide_Id) + (1 | sample)")

config <- istar$config
config$hierarchy_keys_depth()
#> [1] "protein_Id"

mod <- build_model(
  istar$data,
  modelFunction,
  subject_id = config$hierarchy_keys_depth()
)
#> boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')
#> boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')
#> boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')
#> boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')
#> boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')
#> Warning: fit (Model): 4 fits failed (e.g. 7cbcrd~5725, 9VUkAq~4703, CGzoYe~2147, DoWup2~5896): Error: grouping factors must have > 1 sampled level
#> See $provenance().
#> fit (Model): 5 singular fits (e.g. 0EfVhX~0087, Fl4JiV~8625, HvIpHG~9079, JcKVfU~9653, SGIVBl~5782): coefficients not estimable or fewer than 2 residual df
#> fit (Model): 32 missing responses dropped (e.g. 0EfVhX~0087, BEJI92~5282, Fl4JiV~8625, HvIpHG~9079, SGIVBl~5782): NA response (missing observation) left out of the fit
#> See $provenance().

ref_lfc <- data.frame(
  `(Intercept)` = c(0, 0, 0),
  group_B = c(0, 1, 0),
  group_Ctrl = c(-1, -1, 1),
  row.names = c("groupA_vs_Ctrl", "dil.e_vs_b", "dil.ctrl_vs_b")
)
Contr <- c(
  "groupA_vs_Ctrl" = "group_A - group_Ctrl",
  "dil.e_vs_b" = "group_B - group_Ctrl",
  "dil.ctrl_vs_b" = "group_Ctrl - group_A"
)
contrastX <- prolfqua::Contrasts$new(mod, Contr)
y <- contrastX$get_linfct(avg = FALSE)
stopifnot(all(ref_lfc == y))
t <- contrastX$get_linfct(global = FALSE)

x <- contrastX$get_contrasts()
stopifnot(all(x$p.value < 1 & x$p.value > 0))
stopifnot(all(x$avgAbd > 0))
stopifnot(all(x$FDR > 0 & x$FDR < 1))

x <- contrastX$get_contrast_sides()
xd <- contrastX$column_description()
modelFunction <-
  strategy_lm("abundance  ~ group_")
mod <- build_model(
  istar$data,
  modelFunction,
  subject_id = config$hierarchy_keys_depth()
)
#> fit (Model): 36 missing responses dropped (e.g. 0EfVhX~0087, 7cbcrd~5725, 9VUkAq~4703, BEJI92~5282, CGzoYe~2147, ...): NA response (missing observation) left out of the fit
#> See $provenance().
contrastX <- prolfqua::Contrasts$new(mod, Contr)
y <- contrastX$get_linfct(avg = FALSE)
stopifnot(all(ref_lfc == y))
